backend/main.mo: Main actor for a social media backend on ICP, defining types and logic for posts, comments, user profiles, follows, messaging, and notifications, with access control and blob storage mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that converts the followingMap from a single-principal map and followersMap from a nested map to Set-based structures for the new actor state.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two features: fixing the follow/unfollow button on UserProfilePage and wiring up follow/unfollow React Query mutation hooks in useQueries.ts, with associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing one- to two-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference document for the project's frontend components and pages.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining OKLCH-based light and dark mode CSS custom properties for the app's color tokens, borders, and sidebar theming.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the frontend app with the page title set to 'InstaV' and a script tag loading the main React entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that wraps the app with ThemeProvider (dark default), InternetIdentityProvider, React Query's QueryClientProvider, the router, and a Toaster notification component.
frontend/src/components/AvatarPlaceholde: Reusable avatar component that renders a profile picture from an ExternalBlob URL or falls back to a gradient circle with initials, supporting multiple sizes and both legacy and new prop naming conventions.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with six icon-labeled tabs (Home, Explore, ShortSport, Messages, Create, Profile), active state highlighting, and a dot badge on Messages when conversations exist; hidden on the /shortsport route.
frontend/src/components/CommentsSheet.ts: A bottom sheet component for displaying and submitting comments on a post, supporting both open/onOpenChange and isOpen/onClose prop conventions.
frontend/src/components/editor/AudioPane: Panel component for managing audio tracks in the editor, supporting file upload, recording toggle, per-track volume/mute controls, and track removal.
frontend/src/components/editor/DesignPan: Panel for configuring canvas design settings including aspect ratio selection, solid color backgrounds, and gradient presets applied to the first clip.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorCan: Canvas component that renders the current video frame using the HTML5 Canvas API, drawing clip backgrounds, text layers, stickers, filters, vignette, glitch, and letterbox effects.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorTim: Timeline component displaying a scrollable ruler, video clip track with scrubbing support, clip removal, and an option to add blank clips.
frontend/src/components/editor/EffectsPa: Panel for toggling a set of predefined visual effects (e.g., glitch, confetti, letterbox) on the editor state, with an active effects summary display.
frontend/src/components/editor/ExportPan: Panel for exporting and sharing a video clip, providing a preview, title/description metadata fields, a download button, and a note directing users to Create Post for public sharing.
frontend/src/components/editor/FiltersPa: React panel component for applying image/video filter presets (e.g., Moody, Noir, Cinematic) and manually adjusting individual filter settings like brightness, contrast, saturation, and vignette via sliders.
frontend/src/components/editor/StickersP: React panel component for browsing emoji stickers by category, adding them as timed layers to the editor, and editing selected sticker properties like size, rotation, and duration.
frontend/src/components/editor/TextPanel: React panel component for adding and editing text layers on video, with controls for font, size, color, bold/italic, alignment, animation, and timing.
frontend/src/components/editor/Transitio: React panel component that displays a library of video transitions (fade, slide, zoom, etc.) and allows applying them between specific clip pairs in the editor timeline.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that wraps all pages with a TopBar, a router Outlet, and a BottomNav.
frontend/src/components/NotificationsPan: A dropdown panel that lists user notifications (follows, messages) with read/unread state, timestamps, and navigation on click.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: A card component for displaying a single post with author info, media, like/comment/view actions, and intersection-observer-based view recording.
A dialog modal that shows a grid of the current user's posts as thumbnails, allowing selection of one to share in a message.
frontend/src/components/TopBar.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with the InstaV brand logo, a notification bell with unread badge, and a sign-out button on the profile page.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: A UI card component for displaying a video post with thumbnail, like/bookmark/share actions, follow button, and a double-tap like animation using mock data types.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Custom React hook and context provider that manages Internet Identity authentication state, exposing login/logout functions, identity, and login status via an AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including user profiles, posts, comments, notifications, and messages via the actor interface.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind CSS, imports Inter and Syne fonts, and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark mode color themes.
frontend/src/lib/mockData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and static mock data arrays for posts, comments, users, messages, and conversations used for UI development and testing.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility functions for class name merging (cn), number formatting (K/M), time formatting, and relative time display (timeAgo).
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePostPage.tsx: Page component for creating a new post, supporting file upload or URL input for media, caption entry, and submission via the createPost mutation.
frontend/src/pages/EditorPage.tsx: Video/design editor page that manages editor state (clips, text layers, stickers, filters, effects) and renders tool panels including export, trim, filters, effects, stickers, and design.
frontend/src/pages/ExplorePage.tsx: Explore page with a sticky search bar and tabs to filter/search posts by caption or author, and search users by handle with debounced input.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Main feed page that fetches and displays all posts as PostCard components, with a comments sheet that opens on post interaction.
frontend/src/pages/MessagesPage.tsx: Full messaging page showing a conversation list and a message thread view, supporting text and shared post messages with unread counts and real-time-style updates.
frontend/src/pages/MessageThreadPage.tsx: Thin wrapper page that extracts a principalId URL param and renders MessagesPage with that principal pre-selected.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Authenticated user's own profile page with editable display name, handle, bio, and profile picture, plus a grid of their posts and follower/following counts.
frontend/src/pages/ShortSportPage.tsx: TikTok-style vertical video reel page that plays video posts one at a time using IntersectionObserver, with mute toggle and optimistic like actions.
frontend/src/pages/UserProfilePage.tsx: Public profile page for viewing another user by handle or principal, showing their posts grid, follower/following stats, and follow/unfollow and message actions.
frontend/src/routeTree.ts: Defines the TanStack Router route tree for the app, mapping URL paths to page components (Feed, Explore, Editor, Profile, Messages, etc.) and exports the configured router instance.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for reading URL query parameters (including hash-based routing), persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL without a page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, border radius, box shadow, accordion keyframes, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Tracks the InstaV project's current state (version 3), listing existing features and pending fix requests focused on making the follow/unfollow button functional and persisting follow relationships to the backend.
